scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Private Cloudflare D1 database for per-company requests and operational records. Cloudflare deploy will provision this database.

OPERATOR_EMAIL.description: Primary RoofQuote Relay administrator's business email address, not a password.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Use a randomly generated secret of at least 32 characters. Never use a password or public example value.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Email sending API key from Resend; use a restricted key and verified sender domain before enabling email.

MAIL_FROM.description: Verified transactional sender, e.g. RoofQuote Relay <notifications@your-domain.com>.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Public Site Key from Cloudflare Turnstile for the app's hostname.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Private Cloudflare Turnstile Secret Key. Do not publish.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Actual HTTPS URL assigned to the Worker after deployment. Update when a custom domain is connected.
